english_source_note: Kronecker's Theorem, Dirichlet's Theorem, and Applications
statement_en: For a given irrational number $\alpha$, for every $\beta\in\mathbb{R}$ and every sufficiently small $\varepsilon > 0$, there exists a positive integer $q_{\varepsilon}$ such that $$||q_{\varepsilon}\alpha-\beta||<\varepsilon.$$
callout_body: 对于给定的无理数$\alpha$，以及$\forall \beta\in\mathbb{R}$，对任意足够小的$\varepsilon > 0$存在正整数$q_{\varepsilon}$使得$$||q_{\varepsilon}\alpha-\beta||<\varepsilon$$
